name: Create Service Request
description: Place a new FHIR ServiceRequest (procedure, lab, or imaging order) for the current patient, specifying code, status, intent, priority, and optional category, requester, and notes.

intent_examples: Create a service request for imaging
Order an MRI for the patient
when_to_use: User wants to order a procedure, lab test, or imaging study
User wants to create a referral or clinical service request
User is placing a FHIR ServiceRequest for a patient
when_not_to_use: User wants to order medication (use create_medication_request instead)
User wants to request a device (use create_device_request instead)
User wants to record an immunization (use record_immunization instead)
User wants to view existing orders

introduction: I'll help you place a service request order. Fill in the procedure or lab code, classification, and optional requester details.

completion.message: Service request placed successfully. The order has been recorded in the patient's FHIR record.

workflow_steps.name: Place Service Request
workflow_steps.description: Enter the procedure or lab code, classify the order, and optionally assign a requester.

context_resolvers.description: Resolve the logged-in user's Patient record so patient_id is available automatically.
